 Coventry 2-0 Sunderland 
 Sunderland have got a big hill to climb in this second half.
 Many thought they could be heading for the drop this season with the added burden of European football.
 Is that theory coming to fruition?

 Brentford 1-0 Nottm Forest 
 Oliver Glasner has made a double change during the break.
 Ryan Yates takes the captain's armband off Morgan Gibbs-White and makes his first appearance of the season, replacing Xaver Schlager.
 Daniel Munoz comes on for Ola Aina.

 A chance to re-group for Milenkovic published at 16:02 GMT 16:02 GMT 
 Brentford 1-0 Nottingham Forest 
 Laura Kenyon 
BBC Final Score reporter at the Gtech Community Stadium 
 Nikola Milenkovic seems to have been seriously rattled by the own goal. 
 The Serbian gave away a free kick in a dangerous area just minutes later. 
 Fortunately for him, Mathias Jensen clipped the crossbar after doing brilliantly to get it up and over the Forest wall from the edge of the box. A fraction away from a Brentford second. 
 Half time probably came at a good time for the defender; a moment to regroup.

 Spurs pay tribute to Kane published at 15:57 GMT 15:57 GMT 
 Tottenham v Crystal Palace (17:30 GMT) 
 Phil McNulty 
BBC Sport chief football writer at The Tottenham Hotspur Stadium 
 Tottenham Hotspur have devoted a double-page spread in today's match programme celebrating Harry Kane's Ballon d'Or win.
 Kane left Spurs in August 2023as their all-time top scorer with 280 goals in 435 appearances and the messages end with: "From everyone at the club and on behalf of Spurs supporters across the world, congratulations Harry."
 A well-deserved tribute to a club legend.
 391 56 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 'You've got to be unpredictable' published at 15:55 GMT 15:55 GMT 
 HT: Bournemouth 1-0 Leeds 
 Scott Brown 
Former Celtic captain on Final Score 
 I'm all up for goalkeepers playing out from the back. When they go high press, trying to get after Bournemouth. 
 I'm all for that little clip over the midfield, striker hold it in, and then the midfield join. You've got to be unpredictable at times.
 68 32 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 'Are we really surprised that Brighton are beating Manchester City?' published at 15:53 GMT 15:53 GMT 
 HT: Man City 0-1 Brighton 
 Chris Sutton 
Former Blackburn striker on BBC Radio 5 Live 
 Are we really surprised that Brighton are beating Manchester City? 
 I don't think we are with the way that Brighton have been performing this season. They took the lead and then City have huffed and puffed, had a couple of chances and opportunities, but they should of scored that header.
 Brighton still have plenty of work to do but they are so well organised, and are so impressive. It's up to City to break them down.
 341 88 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 'Brighton have gone toe-to-toe with City' published at 15:51 GMT 15:51 GMT 
 HT: Man City 0-1 Brighton 
 Scott Brown 
Former Celtic captain on Final Score 
 Man City haven't been great. Erling Haaland had one chance, Jeremy Doku is creating chances down that left hand side. 
 It's just that last bit of quality they're missing. Brighton have gone toe-to-toe with them so far.

 HALF-TIME published at 15:49 GMT 15:49 GMT 
 Hull City 0-1 Ipswich Town 
 Ipswich deservedly ahead at the break against a Hull City side that took 35 minutes to get going. Florentino Luis with the goal for Gary O'Neil's side, who have not kept a clean sheet in 10 matches in all competitions this season.
 The three points will be theirs if they can stop Hull scoring in the second half.
